body: The surroundings of Dalat are so diverse that one day is simply not enough to master the art of off-road riding. We’ve designed a two-day Easy Rider course that combines intensive training with a breathtaking journey. From the mirror-like Suoi Vang Lake to the hidden Tyam Tyam Waterfall, you will learn to ride where others wouldn't dare to walk.

Forget the stress of city traffic. You’ll practice gear shifting and clutch control while navigating through picturesque coffee plantations and pine forest trails. This itinerary is built to gradually increase in complexity, allowing you to tackle your first steep inclines and rocky paths with confidence. It’s not just a lesson; it’s a full immersion into the wild highlands. Gain real skills, feel absolute freedom, and discover a Vietnam you won't find in any guidebook. Your journey into the world of Enduro starts here!

Introduction and equipment We meet you in the cafe at the bottom of our house, get to know each other and go up to the apartment. While we pick up the equipment and dress, we discuss your experience (where and how often you have ridden). Based on this, we select the difficulty of the route: we train beginners on the lai, experienced riders are immediately taken to the average difficulty.

Includes: Transfer to the starting point, detailed instructions, and a trial run. Here, you learn how to operate the equipment under the supervision of the guides and take your first confident steps (or runs) before entering the main track.

We set a time limit and set out on the route. The guide does not stray more than 150 meters, waiting for all participants in the shade or on flat areas. During the tour, we provide advice, encourage participants at difficult stages, and take photos/videos at all viewing points.
Includes: A snack on the route and a return to the base. The final stage, where you can rest, share your impressions over a snack, and return to the collection point in comfort.
We can customize a tour based on your preferences and desired dates. Just let us know your requirements, and we will create a personalized tour for you.
The tour price does not include transportation, airfare, or airport transfers, but we can arrange these services at an additional cost if needed.
We also have other larger bikes available for your trips. Please contact us for more information.
The tour price may vary depending on the low/high tourist season or other special requests. Please contact us to get the exact price for your tour.

High-quality Honda XR150L/Honda XR230L/Yamaha WR 155 motorcycle or other motorcycle with a full fuel kit.
The tour price includes meals (1 lunch with local Vietnamese cuisine).

body: This enduro tour is a unique chance to see the surroundings of Nha Trang from a height that is not accessible to ordinary tourists! You will race along the serpentine roads of Khanh Le Pass, the rocky paths of the jungle, and see the wild waterfalls that are hidden from view. The panoramic views are breathtaking, from the emerald jungle to the vast South China Sea.

The medium-difficulty route is the perfect balance of excitement and safety. Experienced instructors will guide you through the forested areas and mountain climbs, ensuring a thrilling experience without unnecessary risks. This is a powerful mix of extreme sports, Vietnam's wild nature, and absolute freedom. The buzz is guaranteed - this day will be the highlight of your vacation!

Introduction and equipment We meet you in the cafe at the bottom of our house, get to know each other and go up to the apartment. While we pick up the equipment and dress, we discuss your experience (where and how often you have ridden). Based on this, we select the difficulty of the route: we train beginners on the lai, experienced riders are immediately taken to the average difficulty.

Includes: Transfer to the starting point, detailed instructions, and a trial run. Here, you learn how to operate the equipment under the supervision of the guides and take your first confident steps (or runs) before entering the main track.

We set a time limit and set out on the route. The guide does not stray more than 150 meters, waiting for all participants in the shade or on flat areas. During the tour, we provide advice, encourage participants at difficult stages, and take photos/videos at all viewing points.
Includes: A snack on the route and a return to the base. The final stage, where you can rest, share your impressions over a snack, and return to the collection point in comfort.
We can customize a tour based on your preferences and desired dates. Just let us know your requirements, and we will create a personalized tour for you.
The tour price does not include transportation, airfare, or airport transfers, but we can arrange these services at an additional cost if needed.
We also have other larger bikes available for your trips. Please contact us for more information.
The tour price may vary depending on the low/high tourist season or other special requests. Please contact us to get the exact price for your tour.

body: The journey from the highlands of Dalat to the coast of Mui Ne is so epic that it demands a full three-day immersion. This isn't just a ride; it’s a legendary transition across Vietnam’s most diverse landscapes. We’ve designed a route that starts in the cool, misty pine forests of the Central Highlands and leads you straight into the heart of the red and white desert dunes.

Over three days, you will face challenging terrains and hidden trails that most travelers never even see. From river crossings to the vast freedom of the desert sands, this is a total rush of adrenaline and honest extreme. This three-day adventure happens once in a lifetime — book your spot and experience the real driving soul of Vietnam!

body: Это одно из наших самых зрелищных мотопутешествий — 12-дневный тур по главным сокровищам Северного Вьетнама.
